filters.title: Risograph Grain
filters.shortDescription: A restrained print-grain overlay for editorial cards, posters, and texture-driven UI surfaces.
filters.longDescription: Uses fractal noise, grayscale conversion, alpha attenuation, and multiply blending to simulate lightweight analog print grain without overwhelming text or layout surfaces.

baseFrequency.description: Mid-density noise suitable for print-like grain.

numOctaves.description: Low-cost detail layering for subtle analog texture.

alphaSlope.description: Restrains grain opacity so the effect stays supportive rather than dominant.

blendMode.description: Anchors grain into the surface without washing out highlights.

accessibilityNotes: Avoid stacking on dense body text at small sizes.
Prefer low-opacity grain for reading surfaces.

filters.title: Posterization Pass
filters.shortDescription: A discrete tonal remap that compresses continuous color into stylized print-like bands.
filters.longDescription: Uses feComponentTransfer discrete channel maps to reduce continuous gradients into controlled tonal steps suitable for ink-print, pop-art, or screenprint-inspired interfaces.

blueTable.description: Three-step blue quantization for warmer print-style contrast.

accessibilityNotes: Do not use on critical photographic detail without testing.
Preserve an unfiltered fallback for image comprehension where needed.

filters.title: Ambient Noise Glass
filters.shortDescription: A light-mode glass surface with soft blur, subtle noise, and restrained specular lighting.
filters.longDescription: Combines blur, alpha shaping, low-opacity procedural noise, and modest specular lighting to create a bright frosted-glass layer that reads cleanly in light interfaces.

blurStdDeviation.description: Softens the source without becoming muddy.

glassAlpha.description: Keeps the body airy for light-mode surfaces.

noiseBaseFrequency.description: Fine static grain for ambient texture.

noiseAlphaSlope.description: Very restrained noise opacity to avoid contamination of text.

surfaceScale.description: Modest lighting relief for subtle highlights.

specularConstant.description: Controls the strength of the reflected highlight.

specularExponent.description: Keeps the highlight broad and soft rather than sharp.

accessibilityNotes: Prefer static noise for reading surfaces and enable animation only on hover or focus.
